tarnished-ancient-crusher.text: Despite its faded luster, this warhammer still bears the valor of an ancient knightly order.

tarnished-ancient-longbow.text: Despite its faded luster, this longbow still bears the valor of an ancient knightly order.

tarnished-ancient-longsword.text: Despite its faded luster, this longsword still bears the valor of an ancient knightly order.

tarnished-ancient-sage.text: Despite its faded luster, this elemental staff still bears the valor of an ancient knightly order.

tattered-eznan-banner.text: A banner bearing the crest of the Eznan Royals. It is severely shredded and worn, barely clinging to its original form.

third-meteor-fragment.text: The third of three shards from a meteor that shattered upon impact. It can be offered at Hersander's Tower. Obtained through exploration.

third-meteor-fragment-10168.text: The third of three shards from a meteor that shattered into pieces upon impact.

third-relic-fragment.text: A fragment of a shattered relic.

throne-of-hinnon-dungeon-key.text: A key that unlocks the entrance to the Throne of Hinnon.

throwing-dagger-65.text: A hastily crafted dagger. Can be assigned to the Utility Pouch.

throwing-dagger-15010401.text: A throwing weapon purchased from merchants. (Level 1) Thrown at distant enemies to increase their Bleed gauge.

toy-ship.text: A toy ship perfectly sized for a child's play. It appears fairly new and intact.

trade-ledger.text: An old ledger, caked in sand and dried blood. Its pages detail clients and trade routes.

transport-wagon-key.text: A key to the Hand of Trust wagon.

travelers-haven-treasure-key.text: A key to a locked treasure chest hidden within Traveler's Haven.

treacherous-crimson-blade.text: Coming Soon - Cannot be equipped yet. A specialized gladius bearing the name of a famed Southern Ephea warrior, and the coward who disgraced it within the arena.

tree-branch.text: A rough, jagged tree branch. A common but versatile ingredient.

tristans-ledger.text: A secret record kept by Tristan. It details countless corrupt dealings and the methods used to maintain his double books.

truthbound-ring.text: Its gentle curves resemble the horizon hidden beyond a thick fog. A ring for those who seek to illuminate the truth in darkness.

turquoise-tower-shield-wall-decor.text: An early shield crafted by Nytro, Austera's master armorer. Now unfit for battle, it serves as decoration.

twisted-scale.text: A Dobavion scale corrupted by Rancor. Used in crafting or can be sold for Gold.

unified-spirit.text: An item that can be offered at Hersander's Tower. Obtained through exploration.

unknown-chest-key.text: A key that unlocks a mysterious chest.

unripe-grapes.text: Unripe grapes. Pale in color with a matte finish.

untarnished-fury.text: When the God of Destruction lay waste to Ayanad and its mages, he unleashed a fury unknown to him since birth. From that moment on, his magic was forever stripped of its gentleness.

unyielding-resolve.text: Even as a god, he could not escape his human flaws. His obsession endured beyond ascension and led to the destruction of the Great Library.

besk-i.text: A small gem fashioned from the Shard of Recollection. In the ancient Ipnysh tongue, "Besk" refers to a sacrificial piece in a divine game of chance, destined for consumption. Visions of the past surface: a broken body, cold gazes looming from above, and the acrid scent of burning corpses. These memories belong to you, yet the faces within them remain those of strangers.

besk-ii.text: A small gem fashioned from the Shard of Recollection. In the ancient Ipnysh tongue, "Besk" signifies a sacrificial piece in a divine game of chance, destined for consumption. Visions of the past surface: you are seated within a swaying wagon alongside a man. An arrow pierces the driver, igniting a desperate struggle. The ambush is repelled, yet the man proceeds to butcher even the kneeling survivors with utter ruthlessness. The name of this cruel man...Gartez.

besk-iii.text: A small gem fashioned from the Shard of Recollection. In the ancient Ipnysh tongue, "Besk" signifies a sacrificial piece in a divine game of chance, destined for consumption. Visions of the past surface: a burning cabin. Rough hands drag you away to face a different man. He towers over you and accepts a cold dagger. Spewing unidentifiable rage and hatred, he plunges the blade deep into your abdomen.

besk-iv.text: A small gem fashioned from the Shard of Recollection. In the ancient Ipnysh tongue, "Besk" signifies a sacrificial piece in a divine game of chance, destined for consumption. Visions of the past surface: an endless line of wagons. The Hand of Trust is a merchant band entering a first bloom of prosperity. A man nearby rushes out to greet a guest. The newcomer is Gartez. The man introduces him to you, but the hand Gartez extends suddenly grips a sword, leveled at your throat.

besk-ix.text: A small gem crafted from a Shard of Recollection. In Ipnya, "Besk" refers to a sacrifice offered in the gods' game. You try to settle some unfinished business with Tristan, but his voice grows cold. Hooded figures emerge from the forest, and suddenly a blow strikes the back of your head. Everything goes black.

besk-v.text: A small gem crafted from a Shard of Recollection. In Ipnya, "Besk" refers to a sacrifice offered in the gods' game. Late one night, you discover Tristan's ledger of illicit trades in a cabin. Suddenly, you feel something cold against your neck and hear a man's voice. It's Slin. He quietly warns you to pretend you saw nothing before leaving the cabin.

besk-vi.text: A small gem crafted from a Shard of Recollection. In Ipnya, "Besk" refers to a sacrifice offered in the gods' game. You walk outside and see that Tristan is arguing with a group of archaeologists. When one of them shoves Tristan, Slin hurls a dagger straight through the man's hand. Leaving him writhing in pain, Tristan walks past you nonchalantly.

besk-vii.text: A small gem crafted from a Shard of Recollection. In Ipnya, "Besk" refers to a sacrifice offered in the gods' game. Surrounded by scattered records, you are researching Black Iron. Slin approaches unnoticed and scoffs, asking if that worthless lump of metal is worth anything before walking away without a second thought.

besk-viii.text: A small gem crafted from a Shard of Recollection. In Ipnya, "Besk" refers to a sacrifice offered in the gods' game. You confront Tristan and urge him to turn himself in. But he takes offense and flies into a rage. He throws his ledger into the flames, showing clear hostility toward you.
